data_split.interpretation: retrospective; August was exposed during prior development

measurement.claim_boundary: No blind-confirmation claim; all August results are retrospective
measurement.reporting_unit: same 721 rolling origins per city and city x seed fold
measurement.uncertainty: paired 168-hour moving-block bootstrap; city x seed is the outer repetition unit

normalization.scaler: source-only equal-city weighted global volume mean/std

purpose: Fair architecture diagnostics under the SCPRC source-only CHARGED protocol

training_budget.budget_matching_unit: effective source windows; optimizer-step counts are reported separately
training_budget.gradient_aggregation: PCGrad for multi-source SCPRC and matched baseline runs unless a baseline-specific control is explicitly labelled
training_budget.loss: standardized volume MSE + 0.15 multi-resolution consistency at factors 2,3,4,6,12
training_budget.pcgrad_parameter_updates: ceil(2048 / 5) = 410 rounds for five source cities
training_budget.source_schedule: round-robin over the five source cities; PCGrad aggregates one task batch per source city per round
